I am Terrill Li, an undergraduate student in the Bachelor of Mathematical Sciences at the University of Sydney. I began in Semester 2, 2026.

This website records what I am learning in mathematics. I share course notes, short proofs, questions, and projects. Some pages are still in progress. I hope to make my thinking clear and improve it over time.

## Interests

I am especially interested in analysis, probability, stochastic processes, and the foundations of mathematics. As I study further, these interests may change or become more focused.

I am also interested in how artificial intelligence affects learning and research. Clear definitions and basic ideas help me use new tools well. They also help me spot gaps in an explanation.

## Current Study

My current coursework includes calculus, linear algebra, mathematical statistics, and discrete mathematics. The [notes](notes/index.qmd) section will grow alongside these courses.
